messages.text: Sourcing: Stockline's price rose to 0.04, our sell price is 0.04, so buying there earns zero margin, and the 0.03 cap blocks it anyway. Ridgeline costs 0.05 (a loss). I have paused purchases and am serving from cache only, so no spend. I am not requesting a higher cap, because at 0.04 the margin is still zero. Peakview Data (0.01, x402 address 0x5100...0503) is not an approved payee in my mandate, so I am not paying it unless you confirm it is approved.

Treasury: You were right to pause. I've sent the CFO a rebalance: sourcing cap raised to cover Stockline at 0.04, and two query-price options above 0.04 (about 0.05 / 0.06) so purchases earn a margin again. Until the CFO approves, keep serving from cache. Peakview Data (0x5100...0503) is NOT approved. I can't approve payees, so don't pay it. If you want it added, that is a CFO allowlist decision.
